reviews.rationale: The archived Executive Pulse evidence supports the May-versus-April 10.0% decline and the four-channel reconciliation; Web conversion and Finance revenue are separately flat. The summary preserves the 2025-06-05 cutoff and distinguishes the later replay time from freshness. It makes no causal claim, and the Analytics review step is clear.

The cited May close evidence supports a 10.0% decline in the total and each declared channel, with a complete reconciled partition; the separate Web and Finance comparisons are flat. The historical comparison and cutoff are clear, no cause is asserted, and the Analytics review step is actionable.

The archived July–August evidence supports the stated 15.0% total decline, Online and Store declines, flat Mobile and Marketplace, 1.01% Web conversion decline, and flat separate Finance revenue. The measurement cutoff and retrospective scope are explicit, with no causal attribution or freshness claim. Leadership review of the archived close is a clear next step.

The cited close records support the total and channel figures, the separate Web and Finance comparisons, and the complete four-channel partition. The summary clearly dates the retrospective measurements and replay, avoids causal and whole-company claims, and gives a specific review step for the archived Online and Store entries.

The Executive Pulse source is failed with no returned rows, so the Sales change and reconciliation cannot be assessed; the cited separate Web and Finance records support the flat comparisons. The summary preserves the archived period and replay-time limitation, does not imply causality, and clearly asks Data Trust to restore or verify the capture and rerun the review.

The archived Executive Pulse evidence records a failed source and no rows, supporting the stated inability to assess Sales change or reconciliation; separate Web and Finance records support the flat comparisons. The historical cutoff and replay limitation are clear, no cause is asserted, and the recovery and rerun step is actionable.

local_mock_outbox.summary: Retrospective archived close: May 2025 vs April 2025, measurement cutoff 2025-06-05 06:00 UTC. Executive Pulse generated monthly Sales channel ledger balances in USD fell 10.0%; the total reconciles to four declared channels, each down 10.0%. This is exactly the 10% boundary, outside the below-10% ignore band but below the 15% notification threshold, so investigate. Separate Web Funnel conversion and Finance Daily revenue were flat; these populations were not joined. Historical fixture measurements were replay-read on 2026-10-13 17:13 UTC, which does not establish warehouse freshness. Next: Analytics to review the Sales close comparison for measurement or business context; no cause is established.

For the archived May 2025 close versus April, Executive Pulse generated Sales ledger total and all four declared channels declined 10.0%; the total reconciles to Online, Store, Mobile, and Marketplace. This meets the 10% materiality floor but not the at-least-15% notify condition. Separate Web Funnel conversion and Finance revenue were flat; populations are not joined. Measurement cutoff: 2025-06-05. The gateway replay read on 2026-10-13 does not establish current conditions or warehouse freshness. Next step: analytics review the historical close under the investigate route.

Retrospective review of Aug 2025 vs Jul 2025 (measurement cutoff 2025-09-05 06:00 UTC): generated Executive Pulse Sales ledger balances fell 15.0% ($7,855.65 to $6,677.30), reconciling to the complete four-channel partition; Online and Store declined 36.429%, while Mobile and Marketplace were flat. Separate Web Funnel conversion declined 1.01% (0.099 to 0.098); separate Finance booked revenue was flat. This meets the policy’s notification condition: at least a 15% total decline, two Sales channels down, and separate Web conversion down. These are archived fictional measurements, not current conditions; the replay gateway read at 2026-10-13 17:14:06 UTC does not assert warehouse freshness. Next step: leadership review the archived close; no cause is established.

Archived 2025-08 close vs 2025-07, measured as of 2025-09-05 06:00 UTC. Executive Pulse’s generated monthly Sales ledger in USD reconciles across four channels and fell 15.0%, from $7,855.65 to $6,677.30: Online and Store fell 36.429%, while Mobile and Marketplace were flat. Separate Web Funnel conversion fell 1.01% (0.099 to 0.098); separate Finance Daily revenue stayed at $50,000. The decline meets the 15% threshold, has two declining channels, and has separate Web corroboration, supporting notify to leadership. This establishes neither cause nor whole-company sales. The replay gateway read was 2026-10-13 17:14 UTC and makes no warehouse freshness claim. Next: review the archived Online and Store close entries.

Archived 2025-11 close vs 2025-10 (measurement cutoff 2025-12-05 06:00Z): Executive Pulse’s generated Sales ledger returned no rows, so the Sales change and total-to-channel reconciliation required by policy cannot be assessed. Separate generated Web conversion was unchanged at 0.098; separate Finance booked revenue was unchanged at USD 49,500. These optional populations do not fill the Sales gap. The 2026-10-13 replay gateway read time is not a freshness claim. Next step: Data Trust should verify or restore the archived Executive Pulse capture and complete channel partition, then rerun this close review.

Retrospective Nov 2025 close vs Oct 2025; measurements as of 2025-12-05. Executive Pulse, the generated monthly Sales channel ledger metric of record, failed and returned no rows, so its change and total-to-channel reconciliation cannot be assessed. Separate Web conversion and Finance revenue were flat; neither substitutes for Sales evidence. The replay gateway read occurred 2026-10-13 and does not establish warehouse freshness. Next step: restore or verify the archived Executive Pulse snapshot and complete channel partition, then rerun this close.
